note: Single source of truth for the cache-busting version query string on every local CSS/JS asset. Browsers cache sub-resources by exact URL, so changing a stylesheet without changing this token leaves every returning visitor — and the CDN edge — on the old file indefinitely. That is exactly what happened between 20260731-museum-v1 and this release: museum-editorial.css was rewritten four times while the token stood still, so the deployed site served the first day's stylesheet. assetDigest is a hash of every file listed below plus assets/js; tests/audit-release-freshness.mjs fails when the digest no longer matches, which is the signal to bump `release` and run `npm run bump:release`.
